title: PRAY THIS MORNING PRAYER BEFORE 7AM AND RECEIVE UNEXPECTED MIRACLES TODAY
text: Glory to Jesus Christ. Glory. Someone just release a shout right now. Not a quiet thing, a shout that tells the heavens you are awake, you are alive, you are positioned. The spirit of slumber has no power over your morning. Do you hear me? I want somebody to understand something in this very hour. There is a dimension of the kingdom that most believers are completely blind to. They wake up, they stumble, they go about their day, and they never access the realm of unexpected miracles that is available to them. >> [music] >> But listen carefully, there is an order, a protocol, a timing that the almighty God has established. >> [music] >> And when you align with that order before the sun rises, when you step into that dimension of prayer, something shifts in the realm of the spirit that causes impossibilities to bow. That causes closed doors to swing open. That causes the very enemies of your progress to become powerless. I declare to you this morning that the season of small prayers and small results is over. The season of prayers that produce small negotiated mercies is finished. We are entering into a season where the bold pray the dangerous prayers, where the committed cry out in the early hours, where the hungry, the desperate, the serious ones make a decision that they will not start their day until they have access the realm of the supernatural. Let me tell you something. Before the sun rises, before the world awakens, before the realm of the flesh begins its noise and its demand, there is a window, there is a corridor of access. There is a dimension of heaven that is unusually open to the remnant who know how to pray. Listen to what the psalmist declares in Psalm 5 verses 3 to 4. It says, "My voice shall thou hear in the morning, O Lord. In the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee, and will look up. Do you understand? The ancient psalmist understood something. There is a morning protocol. There is a morning positioning. There is something about directing your prayer onto God in the morning that is incomparably different from prayers prayed at other times. And then there is this word in Psalm 88 verses 13 to 14. The text says, "But unto thee have I cried, O Lord, and in the morning shall my prayer prevent thee." Prevent. That word it means to go before, to position, to access before the realm of darkness finishes its assignments against your life. Your morning prayer prevents the enemy's agenda. It stops the assignment. [music] It blocks the cause before it can even begin its work. >> [music] >> There are people under the sound of my voice right now who have been praying, yes. They have been petitioning God, yes. But they have been praying at the wrong time. They have been praying in a season when the enemy is already in the position of power, already in the seat of influence, already speaking to their day. And you are coming to God as a negotiator instead of as a co-heir. You are coming as a beggar instead of as one who sits with Christ in heavenly places. That changes this morning. But I want to go deeper. There is something that happens in the early morning hours that most theologians do not even speak about. Most preachers do not even understand it. When you rise before the dawn, when you position yourself in prayer before the world awakens, you are stepping into a realm where the economy of grace is multiplied, where the power of the blood of Jesus is magnified in ways that are incomprehensible, where the angels of the almighty stand at attention because a son or a daughter of God has chosen the pursuit of his face over the comfort of sleep. Jesus himself understood this. Luke 21:37-38 tells us that Jesus would go out and lodge in the mount that is called the Mount of Olives and every day he would rise and come into the temple to teach. Every day. But notice this. Mark 1:35 reveals something even deeper. It says, "And in the morning, rising up a great while before day, he went out and departed into a solitary place and there prayed." Listen to that carefully. Jesus, the Son of God, the King of kings, the Lord of lords, he understood that his power, his authority, his ability to walk in dominion was directly connected to his morning prayer. He would rise a great while [music] before day, not after the day had begun, not in the evening when the work was [music] done, but before daylight, before the world made its demands, before the crowds gathered. He would go into a solitary place and [music] pray. And then when he came back from that time of prayer, >> [music] >> everything he touched was charged with power. Every word he spoke carried authority. Every gesture [music] moved mountains. Every touch healed the sick. Why? Because he had [music] accessed the morning dimension. He had gone to the source before the day began [music] its claiming. I decree and declare this morning that there is no miracle too big for this [music] day. There is no situation too complicated. There is no door too short. There is no enemy too strong. When you access the morning protocol, when you make the decision before the sun [music] rises to position yourself in prayer, the very laws of nature bow to [music] your decree. Sickness bows. Poverty bows. Demonic oppression bows. Closed doors swing open. Let me speak to someone specifically. >> [music] >> There is one under the sound of my message right now and for months, for seasons, you have been struggling with something. You have been in a battle that feels endless. You have been praying, yes, but there is a desperation that has not yet been met. There is a breakthrough that you sense is close, but you cannot quite reach it. Listen to me carefully. That breakthrough is not just in the prayer itself. That breakthrough is in the timing, in the positioning, in the decision to meet God before the world makes its claim on your attention. Rise before 7:00 a.m. Rise when it is still dark. Rise when the realm of darkness is retreating before the light. And in that hour, pray not the prayers you have prayed before. Pray with authority. Pray with declaration. Pray with the consciousness that you are not a beggar, but a son. Not a servant, but a heir. Not a victim, but a victor. I speak to you by the spirit of the living God. >> [music] >> There are assignments against your life that will be aborted this very morning if you rise and pray. There are covenants written in the spirit realm against your destiny that will be broken by the blood of Jesus when you cry out. There are evil altars erected against your marriage, against your children, against your finances, against your health, and every single one of them will catch fire and be consumed when you access the morning dimension of prayer. Thus said the spirit of God, "No weapon formed against you shall prosper this day." Isaiah 54:7 makes it clear. Every tongue that rises against you in judgment, you shall condemn. But listen, there is a condition. There is a timing. There is a positioning. The promise is activated when you walk in covenant alignment. When you refuse to be lazy about your communion with God, when you make a decision that your prayer life is not a hobby, but a lifestyle, that your morning encounter with God is not optional, but essential. That your warfare prayers are not negotiable, but non-negotiable. And let me tell you something about the nature of unexpected miracles. You see, the world teaches you to expect certain things. You expect promotions to come through the natural system. You expect healing to come through medicine. You expect finances to increase through conventional methods. But the kingdom of God operates on a different economy entirely. The kingdom operates on the principle of the supernatural. >> [music] >> Breaking in, the unexpected, the impossible becoming possible, the dead rising, the blind seeing, the bound being loosed. But listen carefully. These unexpected miracles are not random. They are not luck. They are not fate. They are the direct result of someone stepping into covenant alignment with the almighty God. They are the direct result of someone making a decision that they will not let the day begin without first giving God audience, without first positioning themselves in the realm of the spirit, without first accessing the throne room and making their petition known. I want to tell you about something that happened in the life of a man named Jacob. Genesis 32:24-28. Jacob had encountered Esau, his brother, the man he had wronged. He was terrified. He sent his wives and his children ahead. He found himself alone in the darkness. And in that darkness, a man came and wrestled with him all night. [music] All night long they wrestled. And as the sun began to rise, Jacob held on. He refused to let go. And he said to the man, "I will not let thee go except thou bless me." >> [music] >> And the man touched him, changed him, renamed him Israel, a prince with God, a transformer, someone who prevails. And this happened in the early morning hours as dawn was breaking. [music] In that corridor of access between night and day. Do you understand what I'm saying? The most significant transformation in Jacob's life did not come from a sermon. It did not come from someone else's prayer. It came from his own wrestling. >> [music] >> His own determination, his own refusal to let the darkness swallow him, his own cry in the early morning hours. And I declare to you this morning, there is a Jacob season for many of you. There is a wrestling season. There is a season where you must grip the almighty and refuse to let go until transformation comes. Until your name is changed, until your identity is transformed, until you become who God has ordained you to be. And that season is activated by the morning prayer, by the early morning cry. By your determination that before the sun rises, you will have encountered the living God in a way that cannot be negotiated or reversed. Someone shout right now. Tell heaven that you are ready. Tell the enemy that his time is finished. Tell your flesh that sleep is not more important than the presence of God. Tell your circumstances that they have no authority over your morning worship and prayer. Let me take you to another scripture. 2 Corinthians 4 verses 16 to 18. Paul writes, "For which cause we faint not, but though our outward man perish, yet the inward man is renewed day by day. For our light affliction, which is but for a moment, worketh for us a far more exceeding and eternal weight of glory. While we look not at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen." Do you see what Paul is describing? [music] A daily renewal, not a weekly renewal at church, not a monthly renewal at some conference, but a daily renewal. Every single day your inward man is renewed. Every single day fresh mercies come. >> [music] >> Every single day fresh power is available, but that renewal does not automatically happen to [music] you. It happens through you. It is accessed through your positioning. It is activated [music] through your decision to meet with God. And then he says something profound. He says we look not at the things which are seen, but at the things [music] which are not seen, because the things which are not seen are eternal. The things of the spirit realm are permanent. The things of the physical are temporary. [music] So, when you wake up in the morning and you see your circumstances, [music] you see your problems, you see your limitations, you are looking at the things that are seen. You are focusing on the temporary. [music] But when you get on your knees, when you raise your hands, when you cry out to the almighty, you are shifting your focus. You are looking at the things which are not seen. You are positioning yourself in the eternal realm. You are accessing the dimension where God has already decided your outcome. I declare and declare that this morning your eyes are open to the realm of the spirit. The veil is lifted. You see what God has prepared for you. You see the angels standing around you. You see the divine appointments of the day. You see the open doors. You see the blessings that are reserved for you. And you see the enemies attempts as futile, defeated, powerless. Let me speak to someone very directly. There is a woman under the sound of my voice, and you have been barren. You have been hoping. You have been praying. You have been believing for a child. And I [music] speak to you in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ. That barrenness is not your end. That void is being filled. Your womb is opening. Your season of mourning is ending. But listen to me carefully. Before the sun rises this morning, you must rise and make declarations over your body. You must command your reproductive system to come alive. You must decree that every word spoken against your fertility is broken. You must take authority. You must speak to your situation not as a victim, but as a co-heir with Christ. And I see someone else. There is a man and you have been struggling in your business. You have been praying, but success has been elusive. And I speak to you in the authority of the kingdom. Your business is turning around. Your accounts [music] are opening. Your clients are coming. Your doors are swinging wide. But, I decree this morning in the early hours, when the realm of the spirit is most [music] accessible, every covenant you made in ignorance that limits your prosperity is [music] broken by the blood of Jesus. Every curse that was pronounced over your finances through witchcraft is reversed this moment. Every embargo on your provision is lifted. Now, I want to take you deeper into the actual practice. I want to teach you how to pray the morning prayer that breaks the impossible. Listen carefully, because this is not a small thing. This is the difference between a life of struggle and a life of dominion. This is the difference between someone who is tossed about by circumstances and someone who stands as an anchor in the midst of the storm. When you wake up before 7:00 a.m., the first thing you do is not reach for your phone. The first thing you do is not check the news or your messages. The first thing you do is rise. Rise from your bed. Even if your body is tired, your spirit is alive. Rise up. Stand. Position yourself. >> [music] >> And then, thank God. Psalm 100:4 says, "Enter into his gates with thanksgiving and into his courts with praise. Be thankful unto him and bless his name." Before you even make a request, thank God. Thank him for the breath in your lungs. Thank him for the blood that flows through your veins. Thank him for the life you have been given. Thank him for past miracles. Thank him for present mercies. Thank him for future victories. When you thank God, something shifts. The atmosphere shifts. Your spirit shifts. The angels take notice. Heaven leans in because gratitude is the language of someone who trusts. Gratitude is the declaration of someone who knows that God is good and his mercy endureth forever. And then praise him, not petition, not supplication, but pure praise. Psalm 42:8 says, "Yet the Lord will command his loving kindness in the daytime and in the night his song shall be with me and my prayer onto the God of my life. The Lord commands his loving kindness in the daytime, >> [music] >> but you activate it through the night and the morning. You activate it through praise, through worship, through the declaration of his excellence. Sing to him. It does not have to be loud if you're in a home with others, but let your spirit sing. [music] Let your heart overflow. Let your affection for the almighty God be expressed [music] without restraint. Because worship positions you in the correct alignment. [music] Worship reminds you of who you are praying to. Worship shifts your mind from your problem to the problem solver. >> [music] >> And then comes the warfare. And this is where most believers fail. They praise and they thank, but they never enter the realm of spiritual warfare. They never take authority. They never make decrees. They never speak to their situation from the throne room of God rather than from the position of a victim. Ephesians 6:12-18. Paul writes, "For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places. Wherefore take on to you the whole armor of God, that you may be able to withstand in the evil day, and having done all to stand. Stand therefore, having your loins girt about with truth, and having on the breastplate of righteousness, and your feet shod with preparation of the gospel of peace. Above all, taking the shield of faith, wherewith you shall be able to quench all the fiery darts of the wicked. And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the spirit, which is the word of God. Praying always with all prayer and supplication in the spirit, and watching thereunto with all perseverance and supplication for all saints. Do you see what Paul is saying? You must understand that your battle is not a natural battle. Your struggle is not in the realm of the flesh. You are wrestling against spiritual forces. And you must take up the armor [music] of God. But that armor is not taken up casually. It is not put on while you are half asleep, half awake, rushing through your morning. It is put on deliberately, intentionally, with full consciousness that you are preparing for warfare. >> [music] >> So, when you pray the morning prayer, you are not just praying. You are dressing. You are arming [music] yourself. You are speaking into the realm of the spirit with authority and clarity that sets the tone for your entire day. Let me speak to someone right now. There is a young man or woman under the sound of my voice, and you have been struggling with sexual temptation. You have been battling with pornography. You have been wrestling with impurity. [music] And I declare to you this morning, that spirit of lust, that demon that has a grip on your mind and your body, it must flee when you take authority in the morning prayer. When you speak to it not as someone who is weak, but as someone who is covered in the blood of Jesus, as someone who walks in resurrection power, as someone who has been redeemed and is no longer a slave to that. I decree and declare that every chain of sexual bondage breaks this morning. Every demonic assignment to corrupt your mind and your body is aborted. Every unclean spirit that has been assigned to pull you into darkness is cast out and sent to the pit. The cross of Calvary is raised against you, demon. The authority of Jesus Christ is applied against you. And I speak to the young person, you are free. Walk in that freedom. Declare it morning by morning. Do not let the enemy bring shame upon you. Do not let him whisper defeat. You are the righteousness of God in Christ Jesus. Now, I want to take you into the actual declarations and decrees that you must speak because words are powerful. Proverbs 18:21 says, "Death and life are in the power of the tongue, and they that love it shall eat the fruit thereof." Your tongue has power. The words you speak have creative power. They go into the realm of the spirit and they produce results. They set things in motion. They open or shut doors. They release demons or bind them. So, in the early morning hours, before your day begins, you must speak with intention, with clarity, with authority, with the consciousness that you are not just making noise, but you are decreeing into reality. I want you to understand something about the nature of miracles. Unexpected miracles, those breakthroughs that seem to come out of nowhere, those divine interventions that cannot be explained by logic or natural law, they do not happen to the passive. They do not happen to the spectators, they happen to the active participants in the kingdom of God. They happen to those who have activated their authority in Christ. >> [music] >> Let me tell you about a man named Peter. Acts 3:1-7. Peter and John were going up into the temple at the hour of prayer, the ninth hour. And there was a certain man lame from his mother's womb. He was carried and laid daily at the gate of the temple which is called beautiful to ask alms of them that entered into the temple. But Peter, fastening his eyes upon him with John, said, "Look on us." And he gave heed hoping to receive something from them. >> [music] >> Then Peter said, "Silver and gold have I none, but such as I have give I thee." In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, rise up and walk. >> [music] >> And he took him by the right hand and lifted him up and immediately his feet and ankle bones received strength. Do you see what happened? A man who had been lame for his entire life, decades of paralysis, decades of sitting at the gate, decades of begging, and in a moment, in a single encounter, he was healed. Why? Not because Peter had special power, not because the anointing on Peter was something that was not available to others, but because Peter spoke with authority, because Peter took action, because Peter did not see a limitation but a divine opportunity. And notice when this happened, the ninth hour, the hour of prayer, the time when people were gathered to pray, there is something about prayer that creates the opening. There is something about the corporate seeking of God's face that opens the heavens. That is why I'm telling you about the morning prayer, the early morning is your ninth hour. It is your appointment with the throne room. It is your place of access. I decree [music] and declare that before this week is finished, someone reading or hearing this message will experience an unexpected miracle. Something that will shock the people around you. Something that will make no natural sense. Something that will only be explainable by the intervention of the almighty God. And that miracle is connected to your decision to rise and pray. Now, let me tell you about the dimensions of morning prayer that will produce these miracles. Listen carefully because these are not generic prayers. These are specific, targeted, strategic prayers. First dimension, declaration of dominion. When you rise, declare that this day belongs to you, not to the enemy, not to circumstances, not to bad news, to you. And you declare it as one who walks in the authority that Christ has given to you. Philippians 2:9-11 tells us that Christ was highly exalted and given a name which is above every name. And every knee will bow to that name. So, you take that authority, you declare that every demonic force, every dark power, every obstacle must bow to the name of Jesus Christ and to your authority in him. Second dimension, breaking of covenants and curses. [music] There are things spoken over your life. There are generational patterns. There are covenants made in ignorance or malice. There are curses that have been pronounced. And in the realm of the spirit, these things are real. They have power. They function like law until they are broken. So, in your morning prayer, you must specifically break these. You must say, "Every covenant spoken against my life is broken by the blood of Jesus. Every curse that has been assigned to my family is reversed. Every word spoken in witchcraft against my destiny is nullified. [music] Third dimension decree and declaration, you do not just pray, you decree. There is a difference. Prayer is petition. Decree is declaration. [music] When you decree, you are speaking as one who has authority. Job 22:28 says, "Thou shall also decree a thing and it shall be established unto thee." When you decree, heaven establishes [music] it. So, decree your breakthrough, decree your healing, decree your promotion, decree your marriage, decree your children's salvation. Declare it as already done, as already established [music] in the realm of the spirit. Fourth dimension, warfare against specific enemies. Do not pray generic prayers. Identify the specific demonic assignments against your life and speak against them by name. Is it a spirit of lust? Bind it. Is it a spirit of poverty? Break its [music] power. Is it a spirit of sickness? Declare healing. Is it a spirit of fear? Declare courage and boldness. Is it a spirit of division in your family? Declare unity and peace. Fifth dimension, angelic activation. Psalm 91:11-12 says, "For he shall give his angels charge over thee to keep thee in all thy ways. They shall [music] bear thee up in their hands, lest thou dash thy foot against a stone." You have angels assigned to you, but they do not operate on their own. They operate in response to your decrees. They operate when you give them instructions. So, in your morning prayer, speak to the angels. Activate them. Say, "Angels of the Lord, >> [music] >> I command you to go before me today and prepare my path, smooth my way, open my doors, protect my family, deliver from evil, accomplish the will of God in my life. Sixth dimension, time recovery. There are times in your life when the enemy has stolen from you. Years, seasons, opportunities, resources, relationships. Joel 2:25 says, "And I will restore to you the years that the locusts have eaten." The enemy is a thief, but God is a restorer. So, declare, "I recover every moment stolen from me. Every year that has been wasted, every opportunity lost, every resource squandered, I recover it all by the blood of Jesus and the power of resurrection." Seventh dimension, divine appointment confirmation. You are destined for specific things. God has ordained specific things for your life, but you must activate them through your declaration. So, say, "I step into every divine appointment of the Lord for my life this day. I walk in my purpose. I fulfill my calling. I become who God has ordained me to be. Nothing can stop my progress. No demon can block my path. No man can steal my blessing." Eighth dimension, supernatural provision activation. The kingdom of God operates on the principle of abundance. Matthew 6:31-33 says, "Therefore, take no thought saying, 'What shall we eat? Or what shall we drink? Or wherewithal shall we be clothed?'" "For your heavenly Father knoweth that ye have need of all these things. But seek ye first the kingdom of God and his righteousness, and all these things shall be added unto you." >> [music] >> So, declare provision. Declare open doors financially. Declare clients and customers [music] coming, declare increase and multiplication, not as a wish, but as a declaration of faith. Ninth dimension, family covering and protection. Your family's under attack constantly. The enemy seeks to destroy families, to corrupt children, to break marriages. So, declare [music] protection over your spouse, declare covering over your children, declare that no demonic force can penetrate your family's hedge, declare that your children are protected from evil, declare that your marriage is sacred and unshakable. 10th dimension, health and divine healing. Your body is the temple of the Holy Ghost. 1 Corinthians 6: 19-20. But, sickness, disease, infirmities, they seek to occupy that temple. So, declare health, declare that every disease is cast out, declare that your immune system is strengthened, declare that divine healing flows through your body, declare that no sickness can take root in you, declare that you walk in divine health and wholeness. >> [music] >> I want to tell you something that most preachers will not tell you. There is a realm of the spirit where the enemy has been operating against you for years, for seasons, and most of you have no idea. You wake up tired, you feel oppressed, you feel stuck, you feel like you're pushing against a wall that will not give, and the reason is simple, you have not taken authority. You have not done spiritual warfare, you have been living in the natural while the battle is being fought in the spirit. >> [music] >> But, when you begin the practice of morning prayer, when you rise before 7:00 a.m. and you begin to decree and declare, something changes. The enemy's grip loosens, the oppression lifts, the walls begin to crumble, the impossible begins to become possible. Let me tell you about a woman named Hannah. 1 Samuel 1:9-11. Hannah had no children. She was barren, and her heart was bitter, and she wept sore, and prayed unto the Lord. And she vowed a vow and said, "O Lord of hosts, if thou wilt indeed look on the affliction of thine handmaid, and remember me, and not forget thine handmaid, but will give unto thine handmaid a man [clears throat] child, then I will give him unto the Lord all the days of his life." And it says that she continued praying before the Lord, and her speech was in her heart. Only her lips moved. [music] Her voice was not heard, but the Lord heard her, and the Lord remembered her. And in the course of time, she conceived and bare a son, and called his [music] name Samuel. And she said, "Because I have asked him of the Lord." Do you understand what happened? Hannah did not wait passively. Hannah did not accept her barrenness as final. Hannah positioned herself at the temple. Hannah prayed. Hannah made a vow. Hannah put herself into alignment with heaven, and heaven responded, and her breakthrough [music] came. This is what I'm calling you to this morning. Not passivity, not acceptance of the enemy's report, but active [music] participation [singing] in your own breakthrough. Active declaration, active warfare. Active positioning in the morning hour before your day begins. >> [music] >> I speak to someone right now. You have been dealing with a situation for so long that you have [music] become numb to it. You have accepted it as normal. You have stopped expecting change. But I declare to you that your normalcy is about to be disrupted. Your expectation [music] is about to be raised. Something is about to happen in your life that will remind you that [music] God is not dead. That miracles are not just stories in the Bible, that the same power that raised Lazarus from the dead is available to you right now. But, you must act. You must rise. You must pray. You must declare. [music] You must position yourself in the morning prayer before 7:00 a.m. and access the realm of the supernatural. Let me take you to another scripture. >> [music] >> Habakkuk 2:2-3. Habakkuk is told to write the vision and to make it plain upon [music] tables so that he may run that readeth it. And the Lord says, "For the vision is yet for an appointed time, but at the end it shall speak and not lie. Though it tarry, wait for it because it will surely come. It will not tarry." There is [music] an appointed time for your breakthrough. There is a set time. There is a day marked on the calendar of heaven when your situation will turn around, when your blessing will manifest, when your miracle will be revealed. But, you must keep faith. You must not become weary. You must continue to declare until the appointed time arrives. And I say to you this morning, the appointed time is drawing near. For some of you it is today. For some of you it is this week. For some of you it is this month. But, it is near. And you will not miss it if you position yourself correctly. If you pray the morning prayer, if you access the realm of the supernatural. Now, I want to take you into the actual prayer warfare that you must engage in. This is not theoretical. This is practical. This is something you do every single morning before your day begins. First, I want you to pray against the spirit of delay. There is a spirit that seeks to postpone your blessing, to push back your miracle, to make you wait endlessly. But, I declare that this spirit has no power over you. Speak against it. Say, "In the name of Jesus Christ, I speak against the spirit of delay. You have [music] no power to postpone my blessing. You have no authority to push back my miracle. I command you to release every assignment you have against my life. I declare that my blessing comes quickly. My miracle manifest suddenly. My breakthrough is immediate. Second, I want you to pray against the spirit of confusion. The enemy loves to confuse people, to make them uncertain of their path, to make them question their destiny, to make them doubt God's promises, but speak against it. Say in the name of Jesus Christ, I speak against the spirit of confusion. You have no power to cloud my mind. You have no authority to make me uncertain. I walk in clarity. I walk in divine wisdom. I know my path. I know my purpose. I know my destiny. Third, I want you to pray against the spirit of poverty. There is a demonic force that seeks to keep believers broke, oppressed, [music] limited in resources. It whispers that you will never have enough, that you will always struggle, that prosperity is not for you, but speak against it. Say in the name of Jesus Christ, I speak against the spirit of poverty. You have no power over my finances. You have no authority to limit my provision. I declare that I walk in divine abundance. I declare that my accounts are open. I declare that my provision is unlimited. Fourth, I want you to pray against the spirit of sickness. This demon comes to afflict your body, to weaken you, to slow you down, but speak against it. Say in the name of Jesus Christ, I [music] speak against the spirit of sickness. You have no power to afflict my body. You have no authority to make me weak. I declare health. I declare wholeness. I declare that by the stripes of Jesus, I am healed. Every sickness is cast out. Every disease is destroyed, every infirmity leaves my body. Fifth, I want you to pray against the spirit of death. This is the ultimate thief. It seeks to steal life, to bring premature death, to cut short destiny, but speak against it. Say in the name of Jesus Christ, I speak against the spirit of death. You have no power over my life. You have no authority to steal from me. I declare that I live and not die. My days are full, my life is complete. I fulfill my purpose. Sixth, [music] I want you to pray against witchcraft. There are people in the world who practice witchcraft, there are people who speak curses, there are people who walk in the dark to bring destruction. And I declare that their power is broken. Speak it. [music] Say every witch, every warlock, every practitioner of darkness who has made an assignment against my life, I come against you with the fire of the Holy Ghost. I break every curse you have spoken. I nullify every spell you have cast. I render you powerless. By the blood of Jesus and by the authority of the kingdom of God, you are silenced, you are stopped, you are defeated. Seventh, I want you to pray against the spirit of lust.
